C-CLONE-FAITHFUL-TESTS-1-D68520A2.IntentSummary:
This T0 plan converts the approved `C-CLONE-FAITHFUL-TESTS-1-D68520A2` spec into two sequential tasks. **T-001 — the guard and the repair:** land the fixture-read guard in `scripts/audit-regressions.test.ts` (keyed on filesystem-read call sites, batched git calls), which reds on the shipped defect; repair the `C-RECORD-FLUSH-VERB-2-6BB9DF5A flush mode` fixture (`scripts/validate-record-retirement.test.ts:6232`) to a self-contained inline literal and move its F-token references to a record-absent token, which greens the guard; then drive every guard in both directions on copies. **T-002 — the payment:** extend the shipped `bundleMinted` payer map with `F279`, flush `F279` and the chartered row through the shipped `--flush` verb, land the `row relations` walk, and drive the faithful post-close applied-archive copy.
**The pairs this plan owes, each driven in both directions.** T-001: the fixture-read guard (red — the shipped defect; green — the repair); the four repair-discrimination pairs — dropped `flush-row-exists` (reds the refusal test), no `Finding` appended (reds the flush test), skipped root re-derivation (reds the root test), dropped `flush-codify-exists` (reds the refusal test), each reverting green — and the guard's negative controls (`src/review/core.ts:396`'s `node_modules` comparison and the flush engine's segment-assembled buffer read stay unflagged; a planted read reddens naming file and literal). T-002: the `row relations` walk reds before the flush and greens after it, with `moved 2` then `0` at the close. One guard per pair: no guard is landed with another pair's fix.
**Driven on a faithful copy at planning time (rule 19), never against the production record.** The shipped guard's prototype returned exactly the two real hits at the base tree (`scripts/validate-record-retirement.test.ts: .ngrace/scratch/staged-findings.md` and, before the false-positive fix, `examples/polyglot`); after the repair it returned `[]`; a planted read returned exactly one hit naming `scripts/prove-record-preservation.test.ts: .ngrace/scratch/planted-probe.md`; the guard run changed no byte. The four engine mutations each reddened exactly one of the three flush-mode tests, restored green. The flush of `F279` and the row through the verb exited 0 (`record-flush: flushed F279 (row …, pays F279)`); the added `row relations` walk red then green; the record suite 163 pass; the audit suite 46 pass; `bun run typecheck`, `bun run test` (2014 pass, 0 fail) and `bun run validate:ci` all exit 0 at the T-002 state. A fresh clone of base `0044fbe1ef4aaadf9bfd38be0fef90e4a41a51cb` with the two repaired files overlaid, `bun install --frozen-lockfile` and `bun run test` exited 0 (2013 pass, 0 fail) with no `.ngrace/scratch` present. The full close was carried through on a closed copy: `gate approve --artifact plan` permit; baseline, target and final `--run-commands` each exit 0 (2/2, 4/4, 4/4 commands); review 0 findings; `gate verdict` pass; `gate apply` and `gate archive` permit; `apply` archived the bundle; `--retire` `moved 2` then `0`; and on the applied-archive bundle a second `review` plus `gate verdict` whose **last** `Verdict` element carries 8 `AC-*` children — one per close-bound criterion — each `Exit=0 Result=pass` (the first, pre-apply `Verdict` is self-closing and carries none by design). All figures are readings, not criteria.
**What this T0 plan drops from the larger house form, and why each drop is safe.** No teaching task (no skill text moves), no instrument task (T-001 is the instrument), no footprint task (nothing forces a footprint pin), no third task (the closing drive is pass-only and shares T-002's end state), and no `Satisfies` mapping: every authorizing `AC-*` is close-bound (it carries `CloseEvidence`), and `Satisfies` of a close-bound `AC-*` is the shipped `change.close-evidence-and-satisfied` error. `DurableScope` is `` (checked by the shipped predicate, not assumed): both deliverable files are `scripts/*.test.ts`, for which `isModuleOwnableWritePath` is false, and no graph module is written. Baseline needles assert only what the bundle leaves unchanged; **no baseline needle asserts the buffer exists** (`.ngrace/scratch/staged-findings.md` is never named in `BaselineAssertions` — asserting a `.gitignore`d path is the very defect this bundle pays, moved one layer up). The last task ends at the live row and `--rewrite-roots` applied; the close (`gate verdict`, `gate apply`, `gate archive`, `apply`, the production `--retire`) is the authority's.
